templates.content:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "release/**"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
      - name: Build
        run: |
          echo "Build {template_type} for {environment}"
      - name: Deploy Placeholder
        run: |
          echo "Deploy to {k8s_domain}"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {object_name}-{interface_type}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: {object_name}-{interface_type}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: {object_name}-{interface_type}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: integration-service
          image: example/{object_name}:{environment}
          env:
            - name: BW_PROFILE
              value: "{bw_profile}"
            - name: INTERFACE_ID
              value: "{interface_id}"
